vectors.name: device_approval_certificate_structure
vectors.description: Structure of a v0.7 device approval certificate (identity-rooted, self-verifying signature, replay-resistant, user-bound). Binds the account identity signing key (account_identity_pk, 2009 B) into the signed body between approving_device_pk and approved_at, so the device graph is rooted in the account identity key; verify() checks it against the account identity key the relying party independently trusts and rejects a mismatch with IdentityKeyMismatch (TRN-01). Embedded approving_device_pk keeps the signature self-verifying.

verify_inputs.expected_account_identity_pk: caller-supplied trusted account identity signing public key (2009 bytes) — the anchor the device graph is rooted in; a mismatch fails with IdentityKeyMismatch

vectors.name: device_key_wrap_structure
vectors.description: Structure for wrapping keys for specific devices (committing AEAD, AEAD-01 / F01). The encrypted_payload is a committing XChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext with a 32-byte BLAKE3 key-commitment appended, so one wrap ciphertext cannot open under two device keys.

format.description: Recipient device KEM public key ID
Committing AEAD: 32-byte secret + 16-byte Poly1305 tag + 32-byte BLAKE3 key-commitment
